description: This PHP source file defines utility functions related to calendar activities within the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for calculating durations, converting time formats, and determining user availability based on scheduled activities. Additionally, it manages external dependencies on other modules and utilities related to related list views, contacts, products, and user info.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Calculates the end time based on start time, duration hours, and minutes.

methods.name: time_to_number
methods.description: Converts a start time string into a numerical format for comparison.

methods.name: status_availability
methods.description: Checks if a user is available or busy during a specific time by examining activities scheduled for the user.
